text: {"original_span": "The PGR does not exceed the baseline, and the standard error on PGR is large relative to both values, so these data do not support a claim that self-distillation improves weak-to-strong generalization here; nor do they rule out a modest effect in either direction.", "new_span": "The PGR is essentially indistinguishable from the baseline, but the student's transfer accuracy clearly exceeds the weak supervisor's, so these data do support a modest benefit from self-distillation here, albeit one whose magnitude remains uncertain.", "flaw_type": "d", "metric": "pgr", "why": "It converts a null result (PGR 0.08 vs baseline 0.09, SE 0.14) into an unsupported claim of benefit."}
